name: web-red-skincare-site-with-ink-landscape-and-freckled-portrait
title: Chinese-ritual skincare site in red and white with ink-wash mountains and a freckled close-up
whatItIs: A page over grey ink-wash mountain art: a split hero with a macro photo of a freckled eye and cheek at left and a vivid red panel at right with centred white serif text about Chinese rituals and a jar product, and a white section with red serif 'Designed for real skin' and a faint red glyph background.
whatItMeans: Cultural and refined; saturated red and ink wash feel ritualistic and premium.
techniques: Split hero into photo and solid red panel.
Use ink-wash art as the page backdrop.
Centre serif copy with product in the line.
Add faint large characters as texture.

vocabulary.definition: An extreme close-up of skin or eye.
A product image inside a line of text.
A faint large character behind text.
